verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents controls over which events are saved and counted toward the event quota, and offers two options for handling daily quota overages. Together these suggest a mechanism to keep an error storm from producing runaway costs. However, the evidence never explicitly shows per-project quota caps or a hard spend limit, so the predictable-budget guarantee is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit per-project event caps, a documented spend-limit/no-overage-billing setting, details of what the two overage options do, independent corroboration.
